nameEn: Manufacture of plastics and synthetic rubber in primary forms
description: This class includes the manufacture of plastics in primary forms and synthetic rubber.
includes: manufacture of polymers of ethylene: polyethylene (PE)
manufacture of polymers of propylene: polypropylene (PP)
manufacture of polymers of styrene: polystyrene (PS), ABS
manufacture of polymers of vinyl chloride: PVC
manufacture of synthetic rubber: styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR), polybutadiene, neoprene
manufacture of cellulose and its chemical derivatives
excludes: manufacture of articles of plastics, see 2220
